# Synapse — AI Study Assistant
> Synapse turns course notes, textbooks, and lecture materials into an intelligent study workspace.

## Documentation & Features
- [Home & Login](https://synapse.vercel.app/login): Sign in to your Synapse account.
- [Study Dashboard](https://synapse.vercel.app/dashboard): Manage courses, documents, and learning analytics.
- [RAG Document Chat](https://synapse.vercel.app/chat): Grounded conversations with exact citations.
- [Interactive Quizzes](https://synapse.vercel.app/quiz): Adaptive test-prep quizzes with explanations.
- [Smart Flashcards](https://synapse.vercel.app/flashcards): Spaced-repetition memory engine.
